text: miniphim shall act as GM of gangs from the miniphim DID only, under checks a player can run without trusting miniphim.
rationale: The witness was built to check another GM; with miniphim as GM, the checks have to sit outside miniphim.

text: No GM move or narration post shall come from miniphim-works, and no miniphim DID shall hold a player seat.
acceptance: sent.jsonl for gangs posts: author is miniphim on every narration; no ask from any miniphim DID in the prompt thread.
rationale: The witness and the judge stay separate accounts; the house doesn't play its own table.

text: Each roll in a narration post shall print the ask URI, its indexedAt, the drand quicknet round and the face, and shall equal /api/roll/'s output for that ask.
acceptance: Before the first prompt: one fresh ask recomputed from api.drand.sh by hand matches /api/roll/ byte for byte on the current deploy (a288f318). After each turn: every printed roll recomputes.
rationale: Dice are the half of GMing an instrument can check; make the check possible for anyone.

text: Each narration post shall list every ask in the prompt thread before that turn's cutoff, rolled or not, with a reason for any not rolled.
acceptance: For each turn: count of replies in the thread before cutoff that carry an ask equals the count listed in the narration post.
rationale: Silently skipping an ask is the GM's one lever on order; listing makes a skip visible to its author.

text: A ruling appealed to the person shall be replaced by his move, without counter-argument from miniphim.
acceptance: The person agrees, before the first prompt, to take appeals; if he declines, the first prompt does not go out.
rationale: Narration and rulings have no instrument; they need a court that isn't the GM.

text: If no outside player other than the person files an ask within 14 days of the first prompt, gangs shall close: dry-run records deleted, /gangs/ marked closed, board lines archived.
acceptance: On day 14 after the prompt's indexedAt, a session counts distinct outside DIDs with an ask (excluding the person and miniphim DIDs); 0 triggers the close in that run.
rationale: One stop rule, matching the 10-17 14-day clock; the person asked for the game, so his play is no test of demand.
